input.summary: Extend the licence to Sparkling's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our affiliated companies and to contractors and outsourced service providers using the Software on our behalf, and added a successor-transfer right, with conforming changes to Sections 3(c) and 20(d). Our playbook requires operational use by affiliates and contractors and continuity of the licence through a merger or sale of the business; the perpetual term in Section 17(a) is acceptable as drafted.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors and outsourced service providers acting on Sparkling's behalf, a non-exclusive licence, transferable to a successor to all or substantially all of Sparkling's business or assets, to use

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: except (i) to affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors and outsourced service providers acting on Sparkling's behalf as contemplated by Section 2, (ii) to a successor to all or substantially all of Sparkling's business or assets, or (iii) as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;

ops.oldText: without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: without the written consent of the other party, except that either party may assign this Agreement, without such consent, to a successor to all or substantially all of its business or assets by merger, reorganization or sale.
